def transform(grid):
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x not in (bg,1,2)]
    r0=max(0,min(r for r,c in pts)-1); r1=min(len(grid)-1,max(r for r,c in pts)+1)
    c0=max(0,min(c for r,c in pts)-1); c1=min(len(grid[0])-1,max(c for r,c in pts)+1)
    while r1+1<len(grid) and any(grid[r1+1][c]!=bg for c in range(c0,c1+1)): r1+=1
    while r0>0 and any(grid[r0-1][c]!=bg for c in range(c0,c1+1)): r0-=1
    return [row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
